text: APPROVE: the extracted `IsFirstPartySource` keeps the original filter order (extension, then generated/declaration names, then `IsSkipped`), and `&& --count == 0` still decrements only for files that pass, so behaviour is unchanged. Three nested `if`/`continue` blocks and their `||` chains are gone from `AtLeast`, which should bring its complexity well under 15, and the new helper uses only existing members, so it should build. I reviewed the diff only and did not build or run anything.
